title: New members cannot say which kind of reader they are, so nothing downstream can speak to an archetype
detail:
PR 6 (ADR-1715). lib/audience/archetypes.ts is the single registry (id, family, reader, funnel) for the eleven archetypes; the arrival flow keeps the persona question and adds one follow-up per persona in members' own words; the answer is stored at profiles.meta.archetype (app/join/(induction)/actions.ts) and contacts.meta.archetype (app/(marketing)/start/actions.ts); an archetype_<id> tag per archetype in lib/traits/registry.ts; one saved segment per archetype in a new migration modelled on 20260607010000_persona_segments.sql; a help line and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Skipping is allowed. Never sent to an ad or analytics pixel: the step fires a generic event name.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. lib/audience/archetypes.ts is the single registry (id, family, reader, funnel, internalName) and the follow-up map per persona, in members' own words. components/onboarding/arrival-follow-up.tsx asks it, optionally, in the induction and the /start lead chooser; the answer rides one first-party cookie (fq_archetype) and is resolved against the primary persona. Stored at profiles.meta.archetype (both induction writers) and contacts.meta.archetype (captureLead), tagged archetype_<id> (eleven tags generated from the registry, classed sensitive), and segmented by migration 20270346005200_archetype_segments.sql. Help line in getting-started/your-first-week.md and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. No pixel: archetypes.test.ts scans every file that reads the archetype and fails if a track, gtag, fbq, dataLayer or posthog call carries it. Folded in from the launch sweep: the Sunday digest leads with public Events near the member's coarse home cell this week. The Next Steps reorder (photo first) was not made: done row PROG-R9 locks identity then the four nouns, so it needs an owner ruling. Deferred to a later row: stamping Mission Patron on a Crew start without an archetype, and the Builder archetype when a Space sets a price.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const a=r("lib/audience/archetypes.ts");if(!a)fail("there is no archetype registry, so nothing can map a member to an archetype");for(const id of ["wired_professional","transplant","activity_first","evidence_first","host_connector","gathering_host","mission_patron","portfolio_teacher","second_act","studio_keeper","network_steward"]){if(!a.includes(id))fail("the archetype registry is missing "+id);if(!r("lib/traits/registry.ts").includes("archetype_"+id)&&!/archetype_\$\{/.test(r("lib/traits/registry.ts")))fail("no archetype_"+id+" tag is registered, so assignTag would throw")}if(!/meta[\s\S]{0,80}archetype/.test(r("app/join/(induction)/actions.ts")))fail("the induction never writes profiles.meta.archetype")'
verify.note: Fails while the registry, any of the eleven ids or their tags are missing, or the induction never stores meta.archetype.
